waveTitle: Tonal rhythm, the held scene, and two editorial calls
summary: Wave 3 broke through: all five pieces won their blind comparison AND were wowed, each with a named moment — the mother-and-infant scene with type ranged right into the one empty patch of wall; a 40-star flag on a committee room axis with the display set to that axis; a goal sentence broken across a full-bleed twelve-month rule; a 245px "16" seated at the end of a conference table; a masthead baseline registered to a breakwater silhouette. Audit clean, 0 type-over-photograph failures, homepage body copy 106 words. Wave 4 is narrow: the ground still changes only once and early, /pilots/ is four unrelated shapes, and two photographs of real people need editorial decisions.

log.m: Foundation: navy/cream/brass identity, Newsreader + Libre Franklin self-hosted, reveal/line-mask/parallax motion engine, six pages. Oryzo captured at 1440x900 and 390x844.
Launched five builder/critic loops (scroll, pilots, people, forum, chrome) plus a coherence pass, and a media agent sourcing CC-licensed photography.

41 agents, 0 errors. Every piece wins its blind comparison; none was called remarkable. Coherence pass fixed four nav offsets, six label brightnesses, three arrow constructions, a menu that sat in the tab order at every viewport, and three contrast failures.
Production builds were shipping with no photography at all — Figure resolved its on-disk check from import.meta.url, correct under astro dev, wrong under astro build. Dev looked perfect. Fixed.
Design system rebuilt by a single owner (type ladder, three micro registers, two new motion primitives), then five builder/critic loops apply it, then mobile and accessibility, then coherence.
33 agents. Ours won 15 of 15 blind comparisons; zero wows. Audit clean: 0 issues, 0 dead links, homepage body copy 86 words.

The People page was ranking the two co-founders — one on a lighter plate at 86px with a bordered credential column, the other at 53px on flat ground, same title. Wave 3 gives them parity; that is an editorial claim a design should not make on its own.
Regrade the photography and extend the ground system first, then five owners break the single left-column armature and earn one designed moment per page.

First wows: 5 of 5. A tool of mine was blind — audit.mjs reads the DOM background, so cream type over a lit photograph measured against --ink-900 and passed. 22 pieces of type were illegible. photo-meter.mjs now measures real backdrop luminance; failures 22 to 0.

Measured rather than inferred: the reference's DOM is inert — all its motion is one fixed WebGL canvas. The transferable idea is structural and free: hold the visual, move the type. Our site does the inverse.
A held-scene primitive (one scene site-wide, not a gimmick), a real tonal spine, one pilot shape with variation, and two editorial calls about photographs of identifiable people.
